text.tspan: Figure 5: The gain comes from the other products' weather, not from the

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Orange: the blend minus its control, which measures the other products' weather. Blue: the control minus the best single product, which measures the extra columns alone. The control is the blend with every product but the best single one replaced by that product's values from other days of the same month, at the same hour. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, August 2024 to September 2026. Every row is a planned comparison, written into the study plan after the first science review and before the re-run that measured it.'
